summary: Provision per-project 'standup-digest' automation: Jira filter -> Confluence digest -> Slack post
description:
Issue summary:
We need an automated daily 'standup-digest' pipeline per project group that aggregates that day's Jira work items (status changes, blockers, PR links), renders a short Confluence digest page, and posts a concise summary into a designated #<project>-standup-digest Slack channel. The goal is to give asynchronous stakeholders a single, consistent snapshot without manual note capture.

Impact:
- Reduces ad-hoc status pings across #ops and #incidents channels.
- Helps on-call and PMs triage cross-team regressions quickly.
- Will be used by ~12 teams in first rollout; expected to reduce recurring status meetings by ~15%.

Request / Requirements:
1) Create a templated Jira filter for each project that captures: issue keys updated in the last 24h, comments flagged 'blocking', PR links in the description, and major-severity transitions. Filters should be parameterized by project key.
2) Build an automated job (cron via Automation for Jira or an Ops-runner) that runs at 09:30 UTC daily, composes a short Confluence: Project Digest page using a lightweight template (top 5 changed tickets, blockers, merged PRs, brief metrics), and stores under /OPS/Standup Digests/<project>/<YYYY-MM-DD>.
3) Post a 3-4 line summary to Slack channel #<project>-standup-digest with link to Confluence page. If the channel does not exist, create it with restricted posting to bot + designated leads and add it to the project channel list.
4) Include opt-out toggle per project and an easy way to adjust cadence.
5) Ensure RBAC: Confluence pages inherit project-view permissions; digests must not expose private HR or legal tags.

Acceptance criteria:
- For 3 pilot projects (serving-runtime, console, devtools) automation produces digest for 5 consecutive business days with correct ticket lists and working Slack posts.
- Confluence pages created under the correct hierarchy and visible to project members.
- Slack channel created when missing, with bot posting enabled and limited access to posting roles.
- Operational runbook created in Confluence with instructions to disable or modify filters and cadence.

Rollout notes / Constraints:
- Start as opt-in for pilot teams. Full rollout requires coordination with SSO group sync to ensure Confluence visibility.
- Metric hooks needed: post success/failure logs to #platform-ops and create a simple dashboard for run success rate.

Technical notes and hints:
- Prefer Jira Automation for initial PoC. If rate limits or complexity arise, fall back to a small Lambda/runner that uses Jira and Confluence APIs and posts to Slack via an app token.
- Use template variables: {{project}}, {{date}}, {{top_blockers}}, {{merged_prs}}.
- Save each digest page with label 'standup-digest' for easy archival and query.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Daily digest produced and posted for 3 pilot projects for 5 business days; 2) Confluence pages stored under /OPS/Standup Digests/<project>/<date> and visible to project members; 3) Slack channel exists with bot able to post and only designated roles can post; 4) Runbook and toggle to opt-out are available in Confluence; 5) Failure alerts posted to #platform-ops.
